expert_term.en: expert appointed by the court, prosecution or investigating authority (forensic expert on the official register, ad hoc expert), or a party-commissioned private expert in civil cases

appointment.summary_en: An expert must be used where establishing or assessing a fact to be proven requires special expertise (188. § (1)); opinions may be given by an expert or ad hoc expert as defined in the Forensic Experts Act (188. § (2)). Unless the law provides otherwise the expert is used by appointment (kirendelés) by the court, prosecution or investigating authority; no remedy lies against the appointing decision (189. § (1)); the authority may release the expert for an important reason (189. § (5)). The defendant and defence counsel may move for appointment and, if refused, commission a private expert opinion (190. §).

questions.summary_en: The opinion answers the questions put in the appointment (definition of 'a szakértő véleménye' in the Forensic Experts Act). The Be. section that governs formulation of questions, the expert's power to decline questions outside the expertise and to report unasked facts was not verified.

report_contents.basis: 2016. évi XXIX. törvény az igazságügyi szakértőkről (Szaktv.) 47. § (4), (7), (9); 31/2008. (XII. 31.) IRM rendelet 10. § (1)
items_en: findings (lelet): data on the object of examination, methods and tools used, and changes to the object during examination
brief description of the examination method
the expert's opinion (conclusions drawn from the findings, including answers to the questions put)
where an earlier examination took place and the appointment covers it, evaluation of its data and findings
reference to the applicable methodological letter, or reasons for departing from it
the field in which the forensic expert is entitled to give opinions, or that the person acted as ad hoc expert

signature, registration number and stamp imprint (name, forensic-expert status, registration number) of the expert; in electronic submission the expert's name and registration number, delivered by secure electronic delivery service
items_local: ha az ügyben korábban vizsgálat lefolytatására került sor és a kirendelés erre kiterjed, a korábbi vizsgálatra vonatkozó adatok és megállapítások értékelése
a módszertani levélre történő utalás, illetve a módszertani levélben foglaltaktól történő eltérés esetén ennek indokai
annak feltüntetése, hogy az igazságügyi szakértő mely szakterületen jogosult szakvéleményt adni, illetve hogy eseti szakértőként járt el

rights_duties.basis: Szaktv. 47. § (1); Be. (provision on oral presentation, section not verified)
rights_duties.summary_en: The expert cannot be instructed as to the professional findings of the opinion (Szaktv. 47. § (1)). Before an oral opinion the authority establishes identity and absence of exclusion grounds and warns the expert of the consequences of a false expert opinion; the warning and the expert's answer are entered in the minutes. If clarification or supplementation fails, another expert must be appointed.

appointment.basis: 2016. évi CXXX. törvény a polgári perrendtartásról (Pp.) 300. §, 302.-306. §, 307. § (1)-(2), 308. §
appointment.summary_en: Unless the law provides otherwise, an expert is used on a motion, either commissioned by a party (private expert, magánszakértő, 302. §) or appointed by the court. The court appoints an expert on a motion where no party proposes a private expert or an expert from other proceedings, where all private opinions are deficient (aggályos), or to clarify an opinion from other proceedings (307. § (1)). As a rule one expert per question; the expert jointly named by the parties, otherwise chosen by the court (308. §).

questions.summary_en: The motion must state the specific questions the expert must answer (307. § (2)). The court may put questions only on factual allegations covered by the parties' questions and omits questions unrelated to the case or outside the expert's expertise (308. §). For a private expert, the party supplies data and questions without court involvement; the opponent may put questions and seek supplementation (304. §).

items_en: same mandatory content as in the criminal route
items_local: a Szaktv. 47. § (4) bekezdésében előírt tartalmi elemek

rights_duties.summary_en: Before hearing a private expert the court establishes identity, relationship to the parties and absence of exclusion grounds, and warns the expert of the legal consequences of giving a false expert opinion. A private expert must act impartially, independently of the commissioning party's interests, evaluate the opponent's statements, and answer questions at the hearing. A deficient private opinion cannot be used as evidence and its fee cannot be charged as costs.

statute.title_local: 2016. évi XXIX. törvény az igazságügyi szakértőkről; 31/2008. (XII. 31.) IRM rendelet az igazságügyi szakértői működésről
statute.title_en: Act XXIX of 2016 on forensic experts; Decree 31/2008 (XII. 31.) IRM on forensic expert activity

liability.norm: 2012. évi C. törvény a Büntető Törvénykönyvről (Btk.) 272. § (2) a) (false testimony provisions applied to an expert giving a false expert opinion), 275. § (exemption and mitigation)
liability.summary_en: An expert who gives a false expert opinion is punished under the false-testimony offence (hamis tanúzás); penalties differ for criminal and civil cases and for negligent commission. 275. § excludes punishability in listed cases and allows unlimited mitigation or waiver if the falsity is reported before the final conclusion of the main case. Maximum penalties not verified on the official portal (see open_questions).

Paragraph numbering inside Pp. 303. § and 308. § was not confirmed.

Btk. 272. § penalties not verified on njt.hu. Secondary sources (law-firm summaries, not official) state: criminal case 1-5 years (2-8 years if the case concerns an offence punishable by life imprisonment); civil case up to 3 years (1-5 years for particularly high value or interest); negligent commission by an expert (272. § (6)) up to 1 year; 273. § up to 1 year in misdemeanour, other authority or disciplinary proceedings. The task brief cited Btk. 275. §, which per these sources is the exemption/mitigation provision, not the offence.
